Usage: pnpm keyring <command>

  passwd                               Set the owner (web login) password
  agent list                           List agents and their permissions
  agent add <name>                     Create an agent and issue a token (shown only once)

  agent grant <name> <path> <level>    Set access to a folder or note. Path "/" means the whole vault
  agent revoke <name> <path>           Remove a rule (falls back to the parent rule, or hidden)

settings.railLabels: Icons and labels on the side bar
settings.railLabelsHint: Show the name under each button on the leftmost bar
settings.readableHint: Center the text at about 760px. Off uses the full width.
settings.resetDeviceAsk: Reset this device's settings to defaults? Panel widths, tree state and "different on this device only" values can't be restored.
settings.resetDeviceHint: Panel widths, tree state and "different on this device only" values go back to defaults (shared settings stay)
settings.resetShared: Reset display settings for all devices
settings.resetSharedAsk: Reset the shared display settings on all devices?
settings.resetSharedHint: Display settings that follow you (theme, editor, shortcuts…) go back to defaults on every device
settings.scope.allTip: Shared by all your devices (stored in the vault settings file)
settings.scope.deviceOnlyTip: This device uses its own value instead of the one shared by all devices
settings.scope.deviceTip: Only this device (browser or app) uses this
settings.scope.overrideTip: Keep a separate value on this device; other devices keep the shared value
settings.scope.vaultTip: Stored in the vault's {file}, so every device (web, app, server) uses it
settings.serverLanguageHint: Language of the server's own messages and the keyring CLI, and of vault text before the vault language is set
settings.sharedFile: Settings file shared by all devices
settings.sharedFileHint: Workspaces (daily, templates, attachment folder), link format, vault language and display settings that follow you are stored in the vault's {file} (frontmatter), so every device shares them through sync. It does not appear in the tree or search.
settings.showIconsHint: Note icons (frontmatter icon) in the tree, tabs, quick open and search results
settings.templateFolderHint: Notes under this folder (inside the workspace) appear in "Insert template". Variables: {{title}} {{date}} {{time}} {{date:YYYY-MM-DD dddd}}
settings.themeHint: Follow the system setting or pick one
settings.title: Settings
settings.treeAttachmentsHint: Non-Markdown files in a node folder (images, PDFs…) appear as one "N attachments" row under the node
settings.uiLanguageHint: Language of menus, buttons and messages. Follows you to all devices; by default the system or browser language.
settings.updateAvailableHint: Keyring Notes {version} is available. You have {current}.
settings.updateCheckHint: When the app starts, it asks GitHub whether a new version is out. Nothing is downloaded or installed until you agree. Turn off to send no request at startup.
settings.updateNowHint: Ask GitHub now whether a new version is out
settings.vaultLanguageHint: Language of text saved into the vault: "Untitled", conflict copies, default folders, wiki index/log/SCHEMA, weekday names in daily formats, commit messages
settings.weekStartMondayHint: ISO 8601: weeks start on Monday; week 1 contains the year's first Thursday
settings.weekStartSundayHint: Sunday-start weeks are not ISO 8601: week numbers (WW) and the week property may differ from other apps
settings.workspacesKeywords: workspace daily template attachment folder icon order
settings.wsDefaultsHint: Daily, template and attachment settings of this workspace go back to the defaults
status.autosaveOn: Autosave on · click to save now
status.label: Status
status.liveTip: Render while editing: lines without the cursor hide markup
status.sendNowTip: Send changes saved while offline to the server now
sync.auto: Automatic (on open, after saving, every 5 minutes)
sync.disconnectAsk: Disconnect from the server? Notes on this device stay, and they are matched again when you reconnect.
sync.offline: Cannot reach the server. What you saved on this device stays, and sync resumes when connected.
sync.report.conflicts: Some notes had the same part changed differently on both sides, so nothing was overwritten. The original note has the server version; your changes on this device were kept as a copy.
sync.report.keepDevice: Keep this device's value here only
sync.report.merged: Notes edited in different places on both sides were merged automatically (you can undo it from the history):
sync.report.same: This device and the server are the same.
sync.report.settings: Both sides changed the same shared settings differently. The server values were used:
sync.serverHint: Keeps this device's notes in step with your self-hosted Keyring Notes server. Notes changed differently on both sides are never overwritten; a copy is kept.
sync.skip.attachment-changed: the attachment changed on both sides
sync.skip.attachment-local: the attachment changed only on this device and could not be sent
sync.skip.attachment-taken: an attachment with this name already exists on the other side
sync.skip.local-changed: changed on this device during sync; will sync next time
sync.skip.settings-changed: the settings file changed during sync; will sync next time
sync.soloWindow: This window shows one note. Syncing runs in the main window.
sync.unauthorized: The server no longer accepts this device (disconnected in the admin console, or a different server). Connect again.
sync.vaultHintApp: Notes are stored as Markdown in a folder on this device. Editing, search, widgets and history all work without a server.
sync.vaultHintWeb: Notes are stored as Markdown in this browser (IndexedDB). Editing, search, widgets and history all work without a server.
tab.discardClose: "{name}" has unsaved changes. Discard them and close?
tab.label: Open notes
tab.tearOutUnsaved: Save "{name}" first to move it to a new window.
tags.none: #tags in your notes show up here
tags.title: Tags {count}
title.dailyDate: Daily note date (click to edit the full name)
title.dailyWarn: Removing or changing the date makes this note stop being that day's daily note (a different date makes it that day's note, and the date properties follow).
title.label: Note title (node name)
tool.lintLong: Structure check (broken links, orphans, no sources…)
trash.reloaded: History changed, so the list was reloaded
tree.emptyAll: No workspaces · add one in Settings → Workspaces
tree.label: Notes
update.available: Keyring Notes {version} is available. You have {current}.
update.busy: An update is already being installed. Quit again when it finishes.
update.quitAsk: Keyring Notes {version} is available. You have {current}. Install it before quitting? Keyring Notes won't restart; the next time you open it, it opens in the new version.
update.restartCancelled: Restart canceled. The update is installed and will be used the next time you open Keyring Notes.
update.title: Update available
widget.changedRetry: The note changed in the meantime. Try again.
widget.pluginLocal: Plugin "{name}" is drawn in the web app connected to a server. Showing only the {count} results here.
widget.pluginLocal#one: Plugin "{name}" is drawn in the web app connected to a server. Showing only the {count} result here.
widget.pluginNoRender: The default export has no render(el, data, api)
window.notResponding: This window isn't responding and has unsaved changes. Close it anyway? The unsaved changes will be lost.
window.saveFailed: Could not save {names}, so the window stays open.
window.unsaved: Unsaved changes in {names}. Save them before closing this window?
window.unsavedMore: {count} notes have unsaved changes ({names}, …). Save them before closing this window?
ws.deleteAsk: Delete the workspace "{name}" with its {nodes} notes and {attachments} attachments? You can undo this from the notice right after.
ws.hint: Workspaces are the top nodes of the vault. The order and icons here are shared by all devices.
ws.renamePrompt: New name for workspace "{name}" (links are updated)
